However, the significance of the MU‐return relationship is contingent upon the extent to which the MU proxy captures the uncertainty surrounding economic fundamentals associated with exchange rates comprehensively. In summary, this study offers more insight into the role of fundamentals in exchange rate movements and the risk‐return relationship in FX markets with a focus on MU.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出了一个包含方差信念形成的理论研究模型，用以探讨宏观经济不确定性（简称MU）、汇率条件方差和汇率回报之间的关系。该模型假设，如果代理人拥有有偏的、缓慢变动的预期，则存在弱的、甚至是负的跨时风险-回报或MU-回报关系。利用多货币数据进行的实证研究证实了风险-回报关系的负相关性。然而，MU-回报关系的重要性取决于MU代理变量在多大程度上全面捕捉了与汇率相关的经济基本面的不确定性。总之，本研究提供了更多关于基本面在汇率变动中的作用以及外汇市场中风险-回报关系，特别是MU方面的见解。

papers.title_en: Reputation in International Trade: Evidence From the Fukushima Nuclear Disaster
papers.title_zh: 国际贸易中的声誉：来自福岛核灾难的证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT A country's reputation may be an important determinant of its ability to export, but the effect is difficult to isolate from underlying product attributes. We consider the trade impact of the Fukushima nuclear disaster and ask whether damage to the Japanese reputation for food safety played a role in its impact. The disaster led to a large and prolonged reduction in Japanese food export value to the EU by up to 40% immediately following the disaster, compared to products from other East Asian countries, with many products ceasing to be exported for up to four years. Since radiation exposure, capacity destruction, and trade restrictions varied by product and prefecture, we use agricultural production data to identify products unlikely to be affected by these negative supply shocks. Such products still exhibit a sizeable reduction in exports, suggesting that a change in the perceived riskiness of Japanese products in the eyes of foreign consumers could have shaped the trade reaction.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：一个国家的声誉可能是其出口能力的重要决定因素，但这种影响很难从产品属性中分离出来。我们考虑福岛核灾难对贸易的影响，并询问日本食品安全声誉的损害是否在其影响中起了作用。与东亚其他国家的产品相比，这场灾难导致日本对欧盟的食品出口价值在灾难后立即大幅且持续下降高达40%，许多产品在长达四年的时间里停止出口。由于辐射暴露、产能破坏和贸易限制因产品和地区而异，我们使用农业生产数据来识别不太可能受到这些负面供应冲击影响的产品。这些产品仍然显示出出口的大幅减少，这表明外国消费者对日本产品风险感知的变化可能塑造了贸易反应。

papers.title_en: On the Provision of International Public Goods in Dynamic Open Economies
papers.title_zh: 动态开放经济中国际公共品的提供
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This study develops a dynamic two‐country model with an international public good, the stock of which positively affects the productivity of the private‐goods sectors in each country, and the evolution of the stock is determined by each country's voluntary contribution in the form of public investment. Two scenarios are examined: A cooperative solution, in which the countries maximize global welfare, and a noncooperative equilibrium, in which each country maximizes its own welfare. This study examines how globalization affects the countries' contribution levels, the stock of the international public good, and welfare. The country that makes more efficient contributions (i.e., higher productivity of public investment) has a comparative advantage in the good that is more sensitive to the stock of the international public good. In the noncooperative equilibrium, free trade leads to a higher steady‐state stock of the international public good than autarky. Furthermore, in both cooperative and noncooperative scenarios, the country with lower contribution efficiency unambiguously benefits from globalization, whereas the country with higher contribution efficiency may experience welfare losses.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文构建了一个包含国际公共品的动态两国模型，该国际公共品存量对每个国家的私人产品部门生产率产生积极影响，其演变由各国自愿以公共投资形式的贡献决定。研究考察了两种情景：合作解，即各国最大化全球福利；非合作均衡，即每个国家最大化自己的福利。本文探讨了全球化如何影响各国的贡献水平、国际公共品存量和福利。在公共投资生产率更高（即更有效贡献）的国家，在对国际公共品存量更敏感的领域具有比较优势。在非合作均衡中，自由贸易导致国际公共品存量的稳态水平高于自给自足。此外，在合作和非合作情景下，贡献效率较低的国家无疑从全球化中受益，而贡献效率较高的国家可能会经历福利损失。

papers.title_en: Duration of Capital Market Exclusion: An Empirical Investigation
papers.title_zh: 资本市场排除持续期：一项实证研究
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This paper investigates the duration of market exclusion following a sovereign default and its resolution. We employ multiple definitions of market access, differentiating between gross and net borrowing and partial and full access, to measure the time it takes for countries to regain entry into international capital markets following a sovereign default and resolution. Our findings indicate that market re‐access can occur immediately under less stringent definitions but may take several years when more demanding criteria are applied. Middle‐income countries typically regain access more quickly than low‐income nations, with significant variation across historical periods. In addition to traditional push‐pull factors, we find that default‐specific characteristics play an important role in the duration of market exclusion. Key factors influencing re‐access include the occurrence of natural disasters prior to the default, the presence of an IMF program, the severity of investor losses, the country's economic outlook, and global liquidity conditions. These findings contribute to the academic literature on sovereign defaults and inform the design of effective post‐default support strategies by policymakers and international financial institutions.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了主权违约及其解决后市场排除的持续时间。我们采用多种市场准入的定义，区分毛借款和净借款以及部分和完全准入，以衡量国家在主权违约和解决后重新进入国际资本市场所需的时间。我们的发现表明，在较不严格的定义下，市场重新准入可以立即发生，但在应用更严格的标准时可能需要数年时间。中等收入国家通常比低收入国家更快地重新获得准入，不同历史时期存在显著差异。除了传统的推拉因素外，我们发现违约特定特征在市场排除的持续时间中扮演着重要角色。影响重新准入的关键因素包括违约前自然灾害的发生、IMF计划的存在、投资者损失的严重性、国家的经济前景以及全球流动性状况。这些发现为主权违约的学术文献做出了贡献，并为政策制定者和国际金融机构设计有效的违约后支持策略提供了信息。

papers.title_en: Overseas Chinese Networks and Processing Trade in China
papers.title_zh: 华侨网络与中国加工贸易
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Processing trade plays a key role in China's trade liberalization since the economic reform in the 1970s. Using a newly collected dataset of county‐country paired overseas Chinese network matched with firm‐country paired trade data, this study empirically shows that overseas Chinese networks significantly increase the processing exports of firms in China. We find that overseas Chinese networks primarily promote processing export by foreign firms and stimulate outsourcing of production from high‐income and middle‐income countries in Europe and Asia to China. We also find that overseas Chinese networks reduce information frictions to promote processing trade. Finally, we find that overseas Chinese networks are effective in generating large initial trade volumes but play a limited role in expanding the size of existing trade relationship over time.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 自20世纪70年代经济改革以来，加工贸易在中国贸易自由化中发挥了关键作用。本研究利用新收集的县级-国家配对的海外华人网络数据与企业-国家配对的贸易数据，实证表明海外华人网络显著增加了中国企业的加工出口。我们发现，海外华人网络主要通过促进外国企业的加工出口，以及刺激来自欧洲和亚洲高收入和中等收入国家的生产企业外包到中国来推动加工出口。我们还发现，海外华人网络减少了信息摩擦，以促进加工贸易。最后，我们发现海外华人网络在产生大量初始贸易量方面是有效的，但在扩大现有贸易关系规模方面的作用有限。

papers.title_en: Foreign Technology Dependence, Competition Pressure and Firm‐Level Innovation Mode Choice: Theory and Evidence From China
papers.title_zh: 外商技术依赖、竞争压力与企业创新模式选择：来自中国的理论与证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT In this paper, we first establish a series of stylized facts to demonstrate that collaborative innovation, in which firms diversify their R&D activities by outsourcing R&D activities to other research institutes/universities or importing foreign technologies, exhibits better innovation performance than self‐innovation. When facing more intensified foreign competition, only firms whose R&D capacity belongs to the upper‐middle percentiles diversify their R&D activities, whereas other firms' innovation diversification remains unaffected. We next develop a theoretical model to explain the empirical findings. The model incorporates the sequential choices of heterogeneous firms regarding innovation mode, R&D investment, and optimal markup under foreign competition. In equilibrium, a subset of firms switches from self‐innovation to diversified innovation to improve innovation performance and escape competition. After structurally estimating the model's parameters, we conduct a battery of counterfactual experiments, such as varying the degree of foreign‐technology dependence, to identify the optimal path for enhancing Chinese firms' innovation performance amid rising uncertainty in international markets.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文首先建立了一系列风格化事实，以证明企业通过将研发活动外包给其他研究所/大学或引进外国技术来实现研发活动的多样化，其创新表现优于自主创新。在面临更加激烈的外国竞争时，只有研发能力属于上中位数百分位的企业会多样化其研发活动，而其他企业的创新多样化则不受影响。接下来，我们构建了一个理论模型来解释经验发现。该模型结合了异质性企业在外国竞争下关于创新模式、研发投资和最优加成的顺序选择。在均衡状态下，一部分企业从自主创新转向多样化创新，以提高创新表现并逃避竞争。在结构性估计了模型参数之后，我们进行了一系列反事实实验，例如改变对外国技术的依赖程度，以确定在国际市场不确定性上升的情况下，提高中国企业创新表现的最佳路径。

papers.title_en: Innovation Convergence
papers.title_zh: 创新融合
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This paper sheds light on the convergence of innovation (patenting) using data from two‐digit manufacturing industries in 32 countries over the period of 1976–2006. It shows that patenting rates tend to converge over time (patenting growth is faster when initial patents are lower), including within countries (across industries) and within industries (across countries). Notably, the quality (citations and citations per patent) and efficiency (patents per worker) of innovation also exhibit convergence. Convergence is widespread across all countries and industries in our sample, and in all time periods. Country‐level data confirms that patent convergence continued through 2020. Patent convergence is stronger where financial development, international financial integration, and institutional quality are higher, and under the presence of financial policies supportive of financial liberalization. These factors contribute to both within country (across industries) and within industry (across countries) convergence. The results highlight the importance of the financial and institutional environment for the growth of patenting, and ultimately for economic growth and productivity.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文利用1976-2006年间32个国家两位数制造业行业的数据，探讨了创新（专利）的收敛性。研究表明，专利申请率随时间趋于收敛（当初始专利较少时，专利增长更快），包括国家内部（不同行业之间）和行业内部（不同国家之间）。值得注意的是，创新的质量（引用次数和每项专利的引用次数）和效率（每名工人的专利数）也表现出收敛性。在我们的样本中，所有国家和行业的所有时期都普遍存在收敛现象。国家层面的数据证实，专利收敛持续到2020年。在金融发展、国际金融一体化和制度质量较高的地方，以及在支持金融自由化的金融政策存在的情况下，专利收敛性更强。这些因素有助于国家内部（不同行业之间）和行业内部（不同国家之间）的收敛。研究结果强调了金融和制度环境对专利增长的重要性，最终对经济增长和生产率至关重要。

papers.title_en: Environmental Regulation or Financial Constraint? Estimating the Effect of the Green Credit Guidelines on Trade
papers.title_zh: 环境规制还是财务约束？估算绿色信贷指引对贸易的影响
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT China's rapid economic growth has come at a significant environmental cost, prompting policymakers to balance sustainability with development. To advance sustainable economic development, the China Banking Regulatory Commission implemented the Green Credit Guidelines (GCG) in 2012, establishing standards and principles for green credit in the banking industry. By imposing credit constraints on high‐pollution industries, the GCG could affect not only production but also the imports and exports of high‐pollution products. This study uses credit‐unconstrained products as a comparison group and employs a difference‐in‐difference method to determine whether the promulgation of the GCG altered trade flows of credit‐constrained products. Our difference‐in‐difference estimates indicate that the GCG has inhibitory effects on both imports and exports of credit‐constrained products, as the GCG limits bank loan financing for high‐pollution firms. Firm‐level analysis further shows that pollution‐intensive firms reduced their trade in credit‐constrained products.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：中国快速的经济增长付出了巨大的环境代价，促使政策制定者在可持续发展与发展之间寻求平衡。为了推进可持续的经济发展，中国银监会在2012年实施了《绿色信贷指引》（GCG），为银行业的绿色信贷建立了标准和原则。通过对高污染行业施加信贷限制，GCG不仅可能影响生产，还可能影响高污染产品的进出口。本研究以信贷无限制产品作为对照组，并采用双重差分法来确定GCG的颁布是否改变了信贷限制产品的贸易流量。我们的双重差分估计表明，GCG对信贷限制产品的进出口都有抑制作用，因为GCG限制了对高污染企业的银行贷款融资。企业层面的进一步分析还表明，污染密集型企业减少了信贷限制产品的贸易。

papers.title_en: Environmental Effects of Green Credit Policy: Evidence From China
papers.title_zh: 绿色信贷政策的环境效应：来自中国的证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This article uses a quasi‐natural test method to study the environmental effects of China's Green Credit Guidelines on high‐polluting enterprises based on firm‐level data. It turns out that the Guidelines have significantly reduced the emission intensity of HPEs, mainly due to the quality improvement of green innovations, changes in the loan structure, assets optimization, and the relaxation of financial constraints. In addition, we also found that the emission reduction effect is more manifest in state‐owned enterprises and in regions with lower levels of marketization and environmental penalties. These conclusions are of great significance for further green credit policies.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文利用准自然实验方法，基于企业层面数据研究了中国绿色信贷指引对高污染企业的环保效应。结果表明，指引显著降低了高污染企业的排放强度，主要原因是绿色创新质量的提升、贷款结构的变化、资产优化以及金融约束的放松。此外，我们还发现，排放减少效应在国有企业以及市场化程度较低和环境处罚力度较小的地区更为明显。这些结论对进一步的绿色信贷政策具有重要意义。

papers.title_en: The Role of Media in Export Market Selection: Evidence From Chinese Firms
papers.title_zh: 媒体在出口市场选择中的作用：来自中国企业的证据
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The media plays a significant role in shaping public opinion and consumer choices, sometimes inadvertently fueling suspicion of foreign companies among domestic consumers, which can impact foreign firms' export decisions. Utilizing the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) data, we constructed a media inclination index based on global media praise and criticism. We examined how this media bias affected Chinese firms' export market selection behavior using data from 2000 to 2014 across 160 countries. Empirical analysis showed a significant correlation between positive media inclination in the export destination country and higher market entry rates for foreign exporters. This favorable media environment enhances local acceptance, reduces export challenges, increases profitability, and alleviates financing constraints for foreign firms. This effect is particularly pronounced for firms exporting consumer goods, engaged in general trade, and non‐foreign‐owned firms. Furthermore, media bias primarily influences export diversion in the initial exploration stage rather than persistent export behavior. These findings provide valuable insights for firms aiming to navigate global markets effectively.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：媒体在塑造公众舆论和消费者选择方面发挥着重要作用，有时无意中加剧了国内消费者对外国公司的怀疑，这可能影响外国公司的出口决策。利用全球事件、语言和语调数据库（GDELT）数据，我们基于全球媒体的赞扬和批评构建了一个媒体倾向指数。我们使用2000年至2014年160个国家的数据，检验了这种媒体偏见如何影响中国公司出口市场选择行为。实证分析显示，出口目的地国家的积极媒体倾向与外国出口商更高的市场进入率之间存在显著相关性。这种有利的媒体环境增强了当地接受度，降低了出口挑战，提高了盈利能力，并缓解了外国公司的融资约束。这种效应对于出口消费品的公司、从事一般贸易的公司以及非外资公司尤为明显。此外，媒体偏见主要影响出口转移的初始探索阶段，而不是持续的出口行为。这些发现为旨在有效导航全球市场的公司提供了宝贵的洞见。

papers.title_en: Unobserved Wholesale Contracts
papers.title_zh: 未观察到的批发合同
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT A manufacturer with private information about product quality sells through a retailer to end consumers. By hiding wholesale pricing contracts from end consumers, the manufacturer can hide his private information, eliminate signaling distortions and earn higher (expected) profit compared to observable wholesale pricing as well as direct selling; consumers may also earn higher surplus under such contracts even though they do not learn true product quality. Policies that mandate disclosure of quality or of upstream contracts can reduce welfare relative to the equilibrium with hidden contracts. We formalize this interaction as a class of intermediated signaling games—distinct from standard signaling models because of the hidden interaction with the intermediary—and introduce a new belief refinement, IC‐I, tailored to such games and analogous to the Intuitive Criterion.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：一个对产品质量有私有信息的制造商通过零售商向最终消费者销售产品。通过向最终消费者隐藏批发定价合同，制造商可以隐藏其私有信息，消除信号扭曲，并与可观察的批发定价以及直接销售相比获得更高的（预期）利润；即使消费者无法了解真实的产品质量，他们也可能在此类合同下获得更高的消费者剩余。强制披露质量或上游合同的政策可能会降低相对于隐藏合同均衡的福利。我们将这种互动形式化为一类中介信号博弈——由于与中介的隐藏互动而与标准信号模型不同——并引入一种新的信仰细化，IC-I，专为这类博弈量身定制，类似于直观标准。

papers.title_en: The Productivity Effect of Public–Private Partnership
papers.title_zh: 公私合作伙伴关系的生产率效应
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Public–Private partnerships (PPPs) are often employed by public authorities to deliver infrastructure and public services through contracts bundling construction, operation, and maintenance over extended periods. Using a novel dataset covering the universe of Italian district heating plants (DHs) from 2007 to 2014, I show that PPP improves firm‐level productivity by incentivizing investments in higher capital quality. Capital quality—proxied by a thermal density index derived from the characteristics of the DH pipeline network—significantly improves productivity only when combined with PPP procurement. A structural production function approach reveals that a one‐unit increase in capital quality raises output by 19% in PPP firms, with negligible effects in non‐PPP firms. Counterfactual calculations suggest that enforcing PPP‐like quality standards across all plants would increase average output by 3266 MWh and reduce CO 2 emissions by 1568 tons per plant per year. The results are robust to selection bias, measurement error, and functional form misspecification. While this paper provides the first evidence that PPPs enhance productivity in network utilities by internalizing technological externalities between construction and operation, whether these gains fully translate into welfare improvements through pricing and Value for Money remains an open question for future research.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）常被公共当局用来通过合同捆绑建设、运营和维护，长期提供基础设施和公共服务。利用覆盖2007至2014年意大利区域供热厂（DH）全样本的新数据集，我展示了PPP通过激励对更高资本质量的投资，提高了企业层面的生产率。资本质量——由DH管网特性衍生的热密度指数代理——只有在与PPP采购结合时才显著提高生产率。结构生产函数方法揭示，在PPP企业中，资本质量每增加一个单位，产出增加19%，而非PPP企业的影响微不足道。反事实计算表明，强制所有工厂执行类似PPP的质量标准，将使平均产出增加3266兆瓦时，每厂每年减少1568吨二氧化碳排放。结果对选择偏差、测量误差和函数形式误设具有鲁棒性。虽然本文首次提供了PPP通过内部化建设与运营之间的技术外部性来提高网络公用事业生产率的证据，但这些收益是否完全转化为通过定价和物有所值带来的福利改善，仍是未来研究的开放问题。

papers.title_en: Financial Incentives for the Development of Blockchain‐Based Platforms
papers.title_zh: 基于区块链平台发展的财政激励措施
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT I develop a theoretical model showing that an entrepreneur prefers to create a decentralized digital platform with a crypto‐token as its internal currency (rather than a traditional platform) when the total surplus from trade is low relative to the dollar value of transactions. I then study inefficiencies in the development of such platforms. When external funding is not required, effort may be above or below its efficient level. When external funding is required, multiple Pareto‐ranked equilibria arise: in each, with strictly positive probability, the entrepreneur liquidates his tokens and halts development.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：我构建了一个理论模型，表明当贸易产生的总剩余相对于交易的美元价值较低时，企业家更倾向于创建一个以加密代币为内部货币的去中心化数字平台（而不是传统平台）。然后，我研究了这类平台开发中的效率问题。当不需要外部融资时，努力水平可能高于或低于其有效水平。当需要外部融资时，会出现多个帕累托排序的均衡：在每个均衡中，以严格正的概率，企业家清算其代币并停止开发。

papers.title_en: Transparency and Innovation in Organizations
papers.title_zh: 组织透明度与创新
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We study how transparency—the observability of interim performance measures—affects innovation incentives. In each of two periods, an agent selects either a new or well‐established idea and exerts effort to implement that idea into products or services. Transparency promotes idea exploration by allowing idea switching in response to negative signals. However, this can become counterproductive by wasting the knowledge acquired through implementation effort and reducing effort incentives if the output relies heavily on implementation effort rather than idea quality. Paradoxically, transparency can be further counterproductive if (1) the acquired knowledge becomes less idea‐specific, (2) the variance in idea quality increases, or (3) the interim performance measure becomes more precise.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究透明度——中间绩效指标的可观察性——如何影响创新激励。在两个时期中，代理人选择一个新想法或一个成熟的想法，并努力将该想法实施到产品或服务中。透明度通过允许在收到负面信号时切换想法来促进想法探索。然而，如果产出严重依赖于实施努力而不是想法质量，这可能会适得其反，浪费通过实施努力获得的知识，并减少努力激励。矛盾的是，如果（1）获得的知识变得不那么特定于想法，（2）想法质量的方差增加，或（3）中间绩效指标变得更加精确，透明度可能会进一步适得其反。

papers.title_en: Fossil Fuels and Renewable Energy: Mix or Match?
papers.title_zh: 化石燃料与可再生能源：混合还是匹配？
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This article investigates the influence of technological ownership on pricing strategies and productive efficiency. Our motivation comes from the evolving landscape of electricity markets where firms are transitioning from diversified to specialized portfolios, focusing on renewable energy or fossil fuels. Our theoretical model demonstrates that diversified firms compete more vigorously than their specialized counterparts. Conversely, specialized firms exhibit higher productive efficiency but only when thermal sources dominate. The magnitude of our theoretical predictions is assessed through simulations using data from the Spanish electricity market. Methodologically, our analysis offers novel insights for studying multi‐unit auctions with cost heterogeneity and privately known capacities.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了技术所有权对定价策略和生产效率的影响。我们的研究动机来自于电力市场不断演变的格局，企业正从多元化转向专注于可再生能源或化石燃料的专业组合。我们的理论模型表明，多元化公司比专业化公司竞争更为激烈。相反，专业化公司表现出更高的生产效率，但仅在热源占主导地位时。我们通过使用西班牙电力市场的数据进行模拟来评估我们理论预测的幅度。从方法论上讲，我们的分析为研究具有成本异质性和私人已知容量的多单位拍卖提供了新的见解。

papers.title_en: Search and Competition in Expert Markets
papers.title_zh: 专家市场中的搜寻与竞争
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We analyze a model where consumers sequentially search experts for treatment recommendations and prices, facing either zero or a positive search cost, whereas experts simultaneously compete in these two dimensions. In equilibrium, experts may “cheat” by overstating the severity of a consumer's problem and recommending an unnecessary treatment, prices follow distributions depending on the problem type and the treatment, and consumers employ Bayesian belief updating about their problem types during search. Paradoxically, as search cost decreases, expert cheating and prices can both increase stochastically. However, if search cost is sufficiently small, competition will force all experts to behave honestly.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们分析了一个模型，其中消费者依次搜索专家以获取治疗建议和价格，面临零或正的搜索成本，而专家同时在这两者上进行竞争。在均衡状态下，专家可能会通过夸大消费者问题的严重性并推荐不必要的治疗来“作弊”，价格遵循取决于问题类型和治疗的分布，消费者在搜索过程中使用贝叶斯信念更新来了解他们的问题类型。矛盾的是，随着搜索成本的降低，专家作弊和价格都可能随机增加。然而，如果搜索成本足够小，竞争将迫使所有专家诚实行事。

papers.title_en: Horizontal Mergers and Incremental Innovation
papers.title_zh: 水平并购与渐进式创新
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We study the impact of horizontal mergers on the incentives of merging firms to invest in incremental innovation. We provide a decomposition of this impact that clarifies the various forces at work and the differences between demand‐enhancing and cost‐reducing innovation. Moreover, we derive sufficient conditions for a merger to either reduce or raise the merging firms' incentives to innovate, and show that the comparison of the price diversion ratio and the innovation diversion ratio can help screen mergers. We also uncover a useful connection between the level of production synergies induced by a merger and its impact on innovation.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究了水平合并对合并企业投资于渐进式创新的激励的影响。我们提供了这种影响的分解，阐明了各种作用力以及需求增强型创新和成本降低型创新之间的差异。此外，我们推导出了合并减少或提高合并企业创新激励的充分条件，并表明价格转移比率与创新转移比率的比较可以帮助筛选合并。我们还揭示了由合并引起的生产协同效应水平与其对创新影响之间的有用联系。

papers.title_en: Stable Price Dispersion under Heterogeneous Buyer Consideration
papers.title_zh: 异质性买家考虑下的稳定价格离散
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We study the pricing of homogeneous products sold to customers who consider different sets of suppliers. We identify prices that are stable in the sense that no firm wishes to undercut a rival or to raise its price when rivals are able to respond by offering special deals. We derive stable and dispersed prices across several price‐consideration specifications. We contrast the implications against those of conventional approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究了向考虑不同供应商集合的顾客销售同质产品的定价问题。我们确定了稳定的价格，即没有公司希望在竞争对手能够通过提供特殊交易来回应时，降低价格以削弱对手或提高价格。我们推导出了几种价格考虑规范下的稳定和分散的价格。我们将这些含义与传统方法的含义进行了对比。

papers.title_en: Network Competition in the Airline Industry: An Empirical Framework
papers.title_zh: 航空业网络竞争：一个实证框架
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This article proposes an empirical framework and a novel equilibrium concept to analyze network competition in the airline industry. A two‐stage entry model links direct and indirect flights, using a technological relationship estimated from data to mimic the hub‐and‐spoke network. It employs revealed‐preference arguments to bound fixed cost parameters, estimated using state‐of‐the‐art econometric methods. Ignoring network externality undervalues the benefits of additional flights by 13.2% and leads to 21.5% fewer one‐stop flights. A hypothetical merger between Alaska and Virgin in 2014 could increase consumer surplus as the merged airline would offer more flights with muted post‐merger prices.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出了一个实证框架和一个新的均衡概念，用以分析航空业中的网络竞争。一个两阶段进入模型将直飞和转机联系起来，利用从数据中估计出的技术关系来模拟枢纽-辐射网络。它采用显示偏好论点来界定固定成本参数，这些参数是使用最先进的计量经济学方法估计的。忽视网络外部性会低估额外航班的好处13.2%，并导致转机航班减少21.5%。2014年阿拉斯加和维珍航空之间的假设合并可能会增加消费者剩余，因为合并后的航空公司会提供更多航班，并且合并后的价格会有所抑制。

papers.title_en: Optimal Job Design and Information Elicitation
papers.title_zh: 最优工作设计和信息引出
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT When managers rely on their subordinates for local information but cannot commit to how such information is used, the incentives for effort and information elicitation become intertwined. This incentive problem influences the firm's job design decision, that is, whether to assign all tasks in a job to one worker (“individual assignment”) or split those among a group (“team assignment”). Team assignment facilitates information elicitation but suffers from diseconomies of scope in incentive provision. The optimal job design is driven by the workers' likelihood of being informed (about local conditions) and the noise in the performance measure used to reward them.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：当管理者依赖下属提供当地信息，但又无法承诺如何使用这些信息时，努力激励和信息激励就变得相互交织。这种激励问题影响着公司的工作设计决策，即是否将所有任务分配给一个工人（“个人分配”）还是将任务分配给一个团队（“团队分配”）。团队分配有助于信息激励，但在激励提供上存在范围不经济。最优的工作设计取决于工人被告知（关于当地条件）的可能性以及用于奖励他们的绩效衡量中的噪声。

papers.title_en: Ad Valorem Taxation in a Multiproduct Monopoly
papers.title_zh: 多产品垄断下的从价税制
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We study the pass‐through of ad valorem taxes with a multiproduct monopolist. We characterize two mechanisms whereby an ad valorem tax on one good reduces all prices (Edgeworth's paradox), depending on the goods being substitutes or complements. We also find that the tax can increase the supply of all goods. Hence, consumer surplus and welfare can increase even when the goods are underprovided compared to the social optimum. We provide several applications where these results hold. Our findings indicate that in a multiproduct setting the effects of unit and ad valorem taxes on market outcomes and welfare are fundamentally different.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究了多产品垄断者对从价税的传递效应。我们描述了两种机制，即对一种商品征收从价税会降低所有商品的价格（埃奇沃斯悖论），这取决于商品是替代品还是互补品。我们还发现，税收可以增加所有商品的供应量。因此，即使商品供应量低于社会最优水平，消费者剩余和福利也可能增加。我们提供了几个这些结果成立的应用实例。我们的发现表明，在多产品设置中，单位税和从价税对市场结果和福利的影响是根本不同的。

papers.title_en: Multi‐Product Monopolist and Information Design
papers.title_zh: 多产品垄断者与信息设计
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT We study the information design and pricing decision of a multi‐product monopolist who faces a buyer with unit demand. Under omniscient disclosure, we show that one profit‐maximizing menu reveals the identity of the highest quality product and allocates that product, provided a type‐specific quality threshold is met. This menu remains optimal under private disclosure if the buyer's value has constant differences in quality and type, or if the value has non‐decreasing differences in quality and type and the threshold type is independent of quality. We also characterize the conditions under which an ex‐ante and non‐discriminatory posted price mechanism is optimal.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们研究了一个面对单一需求买家的多产品垄断者的信息设计和定价决策。在全知披露下，我们展示了一个利润最大化的菜单揭示了最高品质产品的身份，并分配了该产品，前提是满足特定类型的质量阈值。如果买家的价值在质量和类型上具有恒定差异，或者价值在质量和类型上具有非递减差异，并且阈值类型与质量无关，则该菜单在私下披露下仍然保持最优。我们还描述了事前和非歧视性的挂牌价格机制最优的条件。

papers.title_en: Purchase History and Product Personalization
papers.title_zh: 购买历史与产品个性化
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Product personalization opens the door to price discrimination. A rich product line allows firms to better tailor products to consumers' tastes, but the mere choice of a product carries valuable information about consumers that can be leveraged for price discrimination. We study this trade‐off in an upstream ‐ downstream model, where a consumer buys a good of variable quality upstream, followed by an indivisible good downstream. The downstream firm's use of the consumer's purchase history for price discrimination introduces a novel distortion: The upstream firm offers a subset of the products that it would offer if, instead, it could jointly design its product line and downstream pricing. By controlling the degree of product personalization the upstream firm curbs ratcheting forces that result from the consumer facing downstream price discrimination.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要：产品个性化为价格歧视打开了大门。丰富的产品线使企业能够更好地根据消费者的口味定制产品，但产品选择本身提供了有关消费者的有价值信息，这些信息可以被用来进行价格歧视。我们在一个上游-下游模型中研究了这种权衡，在这个模型中，消费者首先购买上游的可变质量商品，然后购买下游的不可分割商品。下游企业利用消费者的购买历史进行价格歧视，引入了一种新的扭曲：上游企业提供了它本会提供的产品的子集，如果它能够联合设计其产品线和下游定价的话。通过控制产品个性化的程度，上游企业抑制了由于消费者面临下游价格歧视而产生的棘轮效应。

papers.title_en: Causal evidence of antitrust damages in the car manufacturers’ cartel in Spain
papers.title_zh: 西班牙汽车制造商卡特尔反垄断损害的因果证据

papers.title_en: Legalization and innovation in the cannabis market
papers.title_zh: 大麻市场的合法化与创新
papers.abstract_en: How would legal institutions affect the rate and direction of innovation in restricted or illicit markets? This paper studies the impact of legalization on innovation in the cannabis market. We construct novel data and measures on cannabis-related innovation in clinical trials and patent applications at the state-year level. We use staggered difference-in-differences models and event studies to analyze the impacts of medical and recreational cannabis legalization (MCL and RCL, respectively) on innovation. We find no evidence that cannabis-related clinical trials respond to MCLs or RCLs. However, there is a marked increase in cannabis-related patenting ( ∼ 4.4 patents) in response to an RCL and more modest impacts from an MCL ( ∼ 1.4 patents). Notably, additional RCL-induced patents are focused primarily on downstream products and methods rather than upstream medical innovation; MCL impacts show a similar pattern. Our further analysis of patent content suggests significant growth in areas that may raise public health, safety, and misuse concerns. These results suggest that legalization increases innovation in the cannabis market, but with relatively weak gains in areas pertinent to health and safe use. We corroborate our findings with multiple new empirical methods in the literature.
papers.abstract_zh: 法律制度如何影响受限或非法市场中的创新速度和方向？本文研究了合法化对大麻市场创新的影响。我们构建了关于大麻相关创新的新数据和度量，包括临床试验和专利申请，以州-年为单位。我们使用交错差异-差异模型和事件研究来分析医疗和娱乐大麻合法化（分别称为MCL和RCL）对创新的影响。我们发现，大麻相关的临床试验对MCL或RCL没有反应。然而，对RCL的反应中，大麻相关的专利申请显著增加（约4.4项专利），而MCL的影响则更为温和（约1.4项专利）。值得注意的是，由RCL额外引起的专利主要集中在下游产品和方法上，而不是上游的医疗创新；MCL的影响显示出类似的模式。我们对专利内容的进一步分析表明，在可能引发公共卫生、安全和滥用问题领域有显著增长。这些结果表明，合法化增加了大麻市场的创新，但在与健康和安全使用相关的领域收益相对较弱。我们用文献中多种新的实证方法来证实我们的发现。

papers.title_en: Specialisation and the career outcomes of inventors
papers.title_zh: 专业化与发明家的职业成果
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have seen a reorganisation of innovation production to favour groups of collaborators, and increasingly specialised individual inventors. In this paper I construct a panel of highly prolific inventors, whom I observe frequently throughout their career. I develop a simple setting whereby inventors face a trade-off between acquiring knowledge depth and knowledge breadth. Empirically, I provide suggestive evidence that after conditioning upon the selection of inventors into specialised careers in certain technological fields, specialisation is associated with a lower probability of contributing to a top-cited invention over the remainder of their career. This suggestive evidence is consistent with a mechanism where specialised inventors are vulnerable to knowledge obsolescence in the late stages of their career. The negative relationship between specialisation and highly cited inventions is concerning given the disproportionate value of such inventions to society. • I create a novel dataset on the careers of prolific inventors. • I integrate career cycle effects into the study of specialisation and productivity. • I develop a measure of specialisation at the inventor-field-year level. • I find specialisation is negatively linked to contributing to top-cited inventions. • I present evidence that this is consistent with a knowledge obsolescence mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，创新生产经历了重组，更倾向于支持合作者群体和日益专业化的个体发明家。在本文中，我构建了一个高产发明家面板，我在整个职业生涯中频繁观察他们。我发展了一个简单的环境，发明家在获取知识深度和知识广度之间面临权衡。从实证上，我提供了暗示性证据，表明在控制发明家选择进入某些技术领域的专业化职业后，专业化与在剩余职业生涯中贡献于顶级引用发明的概率较低相关。这种暗示性证据与专业化发明家在职业生涯后期易受知识过时影响的机制一致。考虑到这些发明对社会的不成比例价值，专业化与高度引用发明之间的负相关关系令人担忧。•我创建了一个关于高产发明家职业生涯的新数据集。•我将职业周期效应整合到专业化和生产力的研究中。•我开发了一种在发明家-领域-年份层面的专业化度量方法。•我发现专业化与贡献于顶级引用发明之间存在负相关。•我提出了证据，表明这与知识过时机制一致。

papers.title_en: Managing alliance portfolio interdependencies for innovation: The role of governance choice in new alliances
papers.title_zh: 管理创新联盟组合的相互依赖性：新联盟中治理选择的作用
papers.abstract_en: Firms can govern their alliances through contractual agreements or equity joint ventures, the latter involving the shared ownership of a newly formed legal entity. This paper argues that the governance choice in a new alliance can be a lever for a firm to manage interdependencies in its alliance portfolio. We examine two related ideas. The first is that the choice of governance structure for a new alliance depends on the composition of a firm's alliance portfolio. The second is that this governance choice has implications for the nature of the firm's innovation outputs. Using data on U.S.-listed dedicated biotechnology firms, we find that firms are more likely to govern a new alliance through a contractual agreement when the accessed resources are similar to the resources available in their existing alliance portfolio. This choice also increases innovation in these similar resource domains. In contrast, firms are more likely to choose an equity joint venture when the accessed resources are complementary to their existing alliance portfolio, a choice that increases innovation in these complementary resource domains. Our findings extend the alliance-portfolio perspective by linking portfolio interdependencies to the governance choices in new alliances and their implications for innovation. • Firms use governance choice in new alliances to manage alliance portfolio interdependencies. • Contracts are preferred when accessing resources similar as in existing alliances. • Joint ventures are preferred when accessing resources complementary to existing alliances. • Governance choice influences the types of innovation outputs the firm achieves. • Contracts foster innovation in similar domains and JVs in complementary domains.
papers.abstract_zh: 企业可以通过合同协议或股权合资企业来管理其联盟，后者涉及新成立的法人实体的共同所有权。本文认为，在新联盟中的治理选择可以成为企业管理其联盟组合中相互依赖性的杠杆。我们检验了两个相关的观点。第一个是，新联盟的治理结构选择取决于企业联盟组合的构成。第二个是，这种治理选择对企业创新产出的性质有影响。利用美国上市的专门生物技术公司的数据，我们发现，当获取的资源与现有联盟组合中可用的资源相似时，企业更有可能通过合同协议来管理新联盟。这种选择还增加了这些相似资源领域的创新。相比之下，当获取的资源与现有联盟组合互补时，企业更有可能选择股权合资企业，这种选择增加了这些互补资源领域的创新。我们的发现扩展了联盟组合视角，将组合相互依赖性与新联盟中的治理选择及其对创新的影响联系起来。• 企业在新联盟中使用治理选择来管理联盟组合的相互依赖性。• 当获取的资源与现有联盟相似时，更倾向于选择合同。• 当获取的资源与现有联盟互补时，更倾向于选择合资企业。• 治理选择影响企业实现的创新产出类型。• 合同促进相似领域的创新，而合资企业促进互补领域的创新。

papers.title_en: The duality of duality: Generative and disruptive climate configurations for innovation
papers.title_zh: 双重性的双重性：创新的生成性和破坏性气候配置
papers.abstract_en: Organizational climate is seen as a key driver of organizational performance, including sustained innovation. However, there is limited work on the effects of climate duality on innovation. The co-existence of two distinct climate dimensions (duality) in an organization creates the potential for both generative and disruptive dualities. By dividing the innovation process into an idea generation stage and an innovation implementation stage, we develop a theory linking climate duality and the generative–disruptive dichotomy at each stage of the innovation process. In particular, we argue that climate duality should be generative at the idea stage and disruptive at the implementation stage. Using data from the 2018 Australian Public Service Employee Census ( N = 59,870), we test the distinct effects of climate duality at each stage. We conclude with a discussion of the implications of these findings for theories of work climate and innovation. • Advance workplace climate research with a configurational approach examining interactions among multiple workplace climates • Theorize relationship between duality (co-existence of go-getter and inclusive climates) and stages of innovation process • Use Australian Public Service Employee Census to show climate duality benefits idea generation (a divergent process) • Find climate duality hinders implementation (a convergent process), revealing paradoxical effects on innovation • Extend theories of climate duality and innovation to public organizations, contributing to cross-sector understanding
papers.abstract_zh: 组织氛围被视为组织绩效的关键驱动因素，包括持续创新。然而，关于气候二元性对创新影响的研究工作有限。一个组织中两个不同气候维度（二元性）的共存创造了生成性和破坏性二元性的潜力。通过将创新过程划分为创意生成阶段和创新实施阶段，我们发展了一种理论，将气候二元性与创新过程中每个阶段的生成性-破坏性二分法联系起来。特别是，我们认为气候二元性在创意阶段应该是生成性的，在实施阶段应该是破坏性的。利用2018年澳大利亚公共服务员工普查的数据（N=59870），我们测试了气候二元性在每个阶段的不同效应。我们以对工作气候和创新理论的影响讨论作为结论。•采用配置方法推进工作气候研究，检验多种工作气候之间的相互作用•理论化二元性（进取和包容气候的共存）与创新过程阶段之间的关系•利用澳大利亚公共服务员工普查显示气候二元性有利于创意生成（一个发散过程）•发现气候二元性阻碍实施（一个收敛过程），揭示了对创新的矛盾效应•将气候二元性和创新理论扩展到公共组织，有助于跨部门理解

papers.title_en: Unlocking firm innovation under regional disadvantage: Can psychological openness compensate?
papers.title_zh: 标题：在区域劣势下激发企业创新：心理开放性能否补偿？
papers.abstract_en: Firm innovation is strongly shaped by regional endowment – defined here as regional supply- and demand-side conditions for innovation – yet many regions are disadvantaged by having low levels of such endowment. While recent research increasingly emphasizes the role of regional soft factors , such as psychological openness, we still know relatively little about how such factors influence firm innovation under conditions of low structural endowment. Theoretically, we draw on Schmookler's scissors metaphor to conceptualize regional supply and demand conditions as hard, structural endowments of regions. We argue that favorable regional soft conditions – specifically psychological openness – can partially offset these structural constraints, but only for firms that possess sufficient absorptive capacity to recognize, absorb, and exploit such favorable regional conditions. Using longitudinal firm-level data on Swedish firms from 2004 to 2018, we show that regional psychological openness does not have a universal positive effect on product innovation. Instead, our results indicate that the benefits of regional openness are concentrated among firms with higher absorptive capacity operating in regions with low endowment, while firms in regions with higher endowment do not benefit in the same way. Implications for research and policymaking are discussed. • Regional soft factors are associated with firm innovation outcomes. • Regional psychological openness may offset regional structural disadvantages. • Firms need absorptive capacity to benefit from regional psychological openness. • Hard and soft factors at firm and region levels jointly shape firm innovation. • In high-endowment regions, psychological openness may coincide with lower innovation.
papers.abstract_zh: 企业创新在很大程度上受到区域禀赋的影响——这里定义为区域创新的供给和需求条件——然而许多区域因禀赋水平低而处于不利地位。尽管最近的研究越来越强调区域软因素的作用，如心理开放性，我们对这些因素如何在低结构禀赋条件下影响企业创新仍然知之甚少。从理论上讲，我们借鉴施穆克勒的剪刀隐喻，将区域供给和需求条件概念化为区域的硬性、结构性禀赋。我们认为，有利的区域软条件——特别是心理开放性——可以部分抵消这些结构性约束，但仅限于那些拥有足够吸收能力以识别、吸收和利用这些有利区域条件的企业。利用2004年至2018年瑞典企业的纵向企业级数据，我们表明区域心理开放性对产品创新没有普遍的积极影响。相反，我们的结果表明，区域开放性的好处集中在拥有更高吸收能力的企业中，这些企业在禀赋较低的区域运营，而在禀赋较高的区域的企业并没有以相同的方式受益。讨论了对研究和政策制定的影响。•区域软因素与企业创新成果相关。•区域心理开放性可能抵消区域结构性劣势。•企业需要吸收能力才能从区域心理开放性中受益。•企业层面和区域层面的硬性和软性因素共同塑造企业创新。•在高禀赋区域，心理开放性可能与较低的创新相吻合。

papers.title_en: Automation, trade and multinational activity: Micro evidence from Spain
papers.title_zh: 自动化、贸易与跨国活动：来自西班牙的微观证据
papers.abstract_en: We use a rich dataset of Spanish manufacturing firms from 1990 to 2016 to shed light on how automation in a high-income country affects trade and multinational activity involving lower-income countries. We exploit variation in firm exposure to robotics inventions over time, as measured using ex ante task specialization and the tasks described in new robotics patents. We show that the deployment of robots in Spanish firms had a positive impact on their offshoring to lower-income countries. For firms that had not yet offshored production to lower-income countries, robot adoption caused them to start newly doing so. By contrast, for firms that were already offshoring to lower-income countries, robot adoption had no effect on their offshoring. • The deployment of robots in Spanish firms had a positive impact on offshoring to developing countries. • Firms that adopted robots started newly offshoring production. • Firms that were already offshoring saw no effect on their offshoring. • Robot adoption had no impact on offshoring to advanced economies.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用1990年至2016年西班牙制造业企业丰富的数据集，来阐明一个高收入国家中的自动化如何影响涉及低收入国家的贸易和跨国活动。我们利用企业对机器人发明暴露度随时间的变化，使用新机器人专利中描述的任务专业化和任务来衡量。我们表明，西班牙企业中机器人的部署对其向低收入国家的外包产生了积极影响。对于那些尚未向低收入国家外包生产的企业，采用机器人导致它们开始这样做。相比之下，对于那些已经向低收入国家外包的企业，采用机器人对其外包没有影响。• 西班牙企业中机器人的部署对向发展中国家外包产生了积极影响。• 采用机器人的企业开始新的外包生产。• 已经外包的企业对其外包没有影响。• 采用机器人对向发达经济体外包没有影响。

papers.title_en: Dinosaurs of the organizational landscape facing technological disruption: Liability of aging and exaptation in monastic orders
papers.title_zh: 组织景观中的恐龙：面对技术颠覆的老化负担与修道会的适应性再利用
papers.abstract_en: Some organizations remain adaptable across centuries while others struggle to evolve and ultimately fade into irrelevance. Only a handful of theories can explain this extraordinary adaptability. We test two competing theoretical perspectives in imprinting research: Liability of aging suggests that older organizations are at greater risk of disruption by modern technologies, but older organizations can also repurpose their imprinted structures and processes to their advantage in a process termed exaptation. To resolve this contradiction, we analyze Catholic religious orders and their monasteries. They represent the oldest extant organizations, were founded in various historical eras, and are facing contemporary challenges posed by digitalization. Our quantitative and qualitative findings indicate that the orders with historically decentralized imprints show higher adaptability in embracing digital innovation. Our results confirm that long-term adaptability is increased in organizations whose imprinted decentralized logics provide a propensity for exaptation. However, these long-standing organizations are also more wary of the negative effects of digital disruption and appear to shield their organizational core more strongly. We contribute to imprinting research by shedding light on the intricate relationship between historically imprinted organizational logics and contemporary organizational practice and highlight the often-underappreciated importance of exaptation for long-term adaptability. • Imprinting theory implies that aging organizations are less able to react to changes. • However, structures adapted for initial conditions may be repurposed. • We test both these assumptions in the organizational logics of Catholic orders. • Catholic orders were founded in diverse eras and face challenges with digitalization. • Historically decentralized organizational logics adapt best to digital innovation.
papers.abstract_zh: 一些组织能够跨越世纪保持适应性，而其他组织则难以进化，最终变得无关紧要。只有少数理论能够解释这种非凡的适应能力。我们在印记研究中测试了两种竞争的理论视角：老化责任理论认为，较老的组织更有可能被现代技术所破坏，但较老的组织也可以将他们印记的结构和流程重新用于他们的优势，这一过程被称为“适者生存”。为了解决这一矛盾，我们分析了天主教宗教团体及其修道院。它们代表了现存最古老的组织，成立于不同的历史时期，并且正面临数字化带来的当代挑战。我们的定量和定性发现表明，历史上去中心化的印记显示出更高的适应性，以拥抱数字创新。我们的结果证实，那些印记去中心化逻辑为适者生存提供倾向的组织，其长期适应性得到了增强。然而，这些长期存在的组织也更加警惕数字破坏的负面影响，并且似乎更强烈地保护他们的组织核心。我们通过揭示历史上印记的组织逻辑与当代组织实践之间复杂的关系，为印记研究做出了贡献，并强调了适者生存对长期适应性的经常被低估的重要性。• 印记理论意味着老化的组织对变化的反应能力较差。• 然而，为初始条件调整的结构可以被重新利用。• 我们在天主教团体的组织逻辑中测试了这两种假设。• 天主教团体成立于不同的时代，面临数字化的挑战。• 历史上去中心化的组织逻辑最能适应数字创新。
